scope: Proposition 11.7 (Compact optimization and continuation) of the manuscript “Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions” (preprints/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d50937326c7cb115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 67. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The optimization in (11.1) is a finite polyhedral optimization with compact sublevels, and attains its minimum whenever feasible. Every optimizer lies on the fixed skeleton. At any parameter admitting an optimizer with q > qbar, the minimum is locally finite and continuous. On full-dimensional generic parameter cells it is affine. Through every optimizer at such a generic parameter there is a local affine continuation by optimizers within its same open stratum cone and with the same active mask.
